detailed_description: The Text Cleaner normalizes pasted text in your browser through a set of toggleable cleanup options. You can trim leading and trailing whitespace, remove empty lines, collapse consecutive spaces into single spaces, strip HTML tags, remove punctuation, delete duplicate lines, and convert the result to lowercase or uppercase. Each option can be toggled independently, so you can combine exactly the cleanup steps your text needs, and the cleaned output updates as you change the settings. It is useful for preparing pasted content for spreadsheets, removing markup from copied web text, deduplicating lists, and normalizing casing before further processing. The tool does not upload your text, support file drag-and-drop, or preserve custom formatting.
usage_steps: Paste your text into the input area
Toggle the cleanup options you need, such as Trim, Remove Empty Lines, or Remove HTML
Enable Remove Duplicate Lines to deduplicate repeated lines in lists
Choose Lowercase or Uppercase if you need consistent casing
Copy the cleaned output from the result panel
usage_examples: Strip HTML tags from text copied out of a web page before pasting it into notes
Remove empty lines and duplicate lines from a copied list of emails or keywords
Collapse extra spaces in pasted table data before importing it into a spreadsheet
Normalize mixed-casing labels to lowercase before loading them into another tool

faqs.question: Which cleanup options are available?
faqs.answer: You can toggle Trim, Remove Empty Lines, Remove Duplicate Lines, Remove Extra Spaces, Remove HTML, Remove Punctuation, Lowercase, and Uppercase. Each option works independently.

faqs.question: How does Remove Duplicate Lines work?
faqs.answer: It keeps the first occurrence of each line and removes any later lines that exactly match an earlier one, preserving the original order.

faqs.question: Is my text uploaded to a server?
faqs.answer: No. All cleanup processing runs locally in your browser, and your text never leaves the page.

faqs.question: Can I combine multiple cleanup options at once?
faqs.answer: Yes. Options apply together in a fixed pipeline, so you can, for example, strip HTML, collapse spaces, and remove empty lines in a single pass.
